tokens.title: Token layer
tokens.intro: Test surface for colours, radii, type roles and the primitive generated by the CLI. Every change to the token layer shows up here immediately.

colors.title: Semantic roles
colors.count: {{count}} roles, each with its own value per mode.

radius.title: Radii
radius.intro: Six steps, following one rule: the larger the container, the larger the radius.

typography.title: Type roles
typography.intro: Every role shown once with wrapping text: a line height that is too tight does not show on a single line.
typography.sample: The portfolio documents student project work at Hochschule Bremen and makes it discoverable across faculties and study programmes.

button.title: Reference component
button.intro: The button generated by the CLI in every variant and size. It proves that CLI, alias, cn(), token bridge and dark mode fit together.
button.label: Button

components.title: Component library
components.intro: All primitives generated with KAN-29 and the hand-composed domain components. Hover and focus states show while interacting; disabled, error and loading states are shown alongside. Check everything in light and dark mode.
